description: Generate a compliance evidence bundle for audit regimes (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR). Enterprise plan required. Returns SHA-256 for tamper verification. Default window is the past 90 days; use date_from/date_to to narrow it.

date_from.description: ISO-8601 or YYYY-MM-DD start of the evidence window.

date_to.description: ISO-8601 or YYYY-MM-DD end of the evidence window.

regime.description: Compliance regime: soc2_type_ii (SOC 2 Type II), hipaa (HIPAA), gdpr (GDPR).
